meaning.en: Luminous nebulae move behind a large hero headline
meaning.zh-Hans: 发光星云在大标题背后缓慢流动

ask.en: Build nebula hero for a full-width banner or sitewide canvas, preserving the reference parameters.
ask.zh-Hans: 为宽幅横幅或全站画布实现星云大图，保留参考参数，并接入真实指针事件。

summary.en: Luminous nebulae move behind a large hero headline.
summary.zh-Hans: 发光星云在大标题背后缓慢流动。

en: Base canvas 539 × 208; 4.8-second loop with phase a = t / 4.8 × 2π. Fullscreen mode lays out against actual width and height.
Luminous nebulae move behind a large hero headline; drawn with Canvas 2D using #a8c9ff, #ddf98b, #c7a6ff and #ffb896 on #080e21.

The gallery simulates the pointer on a deterministic sine path. Interactive mode normalizes pointermove to 0–1 and passes it to render(index,ctx,width,height,time,pointer); leaving restores the automatic path.
Use bundled Motion Sans and switch demo copy with Chinese/English. A sitewide overlay uses pointer-events:none to preserve page interaction. Reduced motion shows a static keyframe.
zh-Hans: 基准画布 539 × 208，4.8 秒循环，采用相位 a = t / 4.8 × 2π；全屏模式按实际宽高重新布局。
发光星云在大标题背后缓慢流动；使用 Canvas 2D 绘制，颜色为 #a8c9ff、#ddf98b、#c7a6ff 和 #ffb896，深色背景 #080e21。
画廊由确定性正弦轨迹模拟指针；互动模式把 pointermove 坐标归一化到 0–1，传给 render(index,ctx,width,height,time,pointer)，离开时恢复自动轨迹。
使用内置 Motion Sans 字体，中英文同步切换；覆盖层 pointer-events:none，不遮挡页面点击；减少动态时保留静止关键帧。

use.en: Large landing-page banners, sitewide pointer layers, immersive space and mathematical backgrounds.
use.zh-Hans: 落地页大图、全站鼠标效果层、沉浸式深空与数学函数背景。

useCases: Hero artwork, backgrounds and pointer-responsive scenes.
limitations: Keep atmospheric effects behind readable content and pause them when off screen.
integration: Use the preview to agree on the visual behavior, then connect it to your product’s content and events. Honor reduced motion and verify the result on a narrow screen.

useCases: 首屏画面、背景和指针响应场景。
limitations: 背景效果应位于可读内容之后，并在离屏时暂停。
integration: 用预览确认视觉行为，再接入产品内容与事件。尊重减少动态偏好，并在窄屏验证结果。

summary.en: Twenty-seven coloured dots form a pointer trail.
summary.zh-Hans: 二十七个彩色圆点在指针后形成尾迹。

en: Base canvas 539 × 208; 4.8-second loop with phase a = t / 4.8 × 2π. Fullscreen mode lays out against actual width and height.
Twenty-seven coloured dots form a pointer trail; drawn with Canvas 2D using #a8c9ff, #ddf98b, #c7a6ff and #ffb896 on #080e21.

The gallery simulates the pointer on a deterministic sine path. Interactive mode normalizes pointermove to 0–1 and passes it to render(index,ctx,width,height,time,pointer); leaving restores the automatic path.
Use bundled Motion Sans and switch demo copy with Chinese/English. A sitewide overlay uses pointer-events:none to preserve page interaction. Reduced motion shows a static keyframe.
zh-Hans: 基准画布 539 × 208，4.8 秒循环，采用相位 a = t / 4.8 × 2π；全屏模式按实际宽高重新布局。
二十七个彩色圆点在指针后形成尾迹；使用 Canvas 2D 绘制，颜色为 #a8c9ff、#ddf98b、#c7a6ff 和 #ffb896，深色背景 #080e21。
画廊由确定性正弦轨迹模拟指针；互动模式把 pointermove 坐标归一化到 0–1，传给 render(index,ctx,width,height,time,pointer)，离开时恢复自动轨迹。
使用内置 Motion Sans 字体，中英文同步切换；覆盖层 pointer-events:none，不遮挡页面点击；减少动态时保留静止关键帧。
